entities.name: 代码评审 (code review)
entities.how_described: 本集说在 PR 产出超出人工验证容量的世界里,代码评审要按第一性原理重做:回答是否违反用户契约、是否增加未来违约倾向、是否实现作者意图三个问题。

evidence.quote: And so we started to think a little bit more about what code review would look like in such a world.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And beyond being interesting, it also makes you wonder, well, their existing systems for validating this code, which is manual code review, of course, testing, maybe you have a QA firm that you work with, naturally can't scale to that same degree.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Instead of saying that we wanted to automate QA or automate testing or automate code review, we took a step back and said, what would we need to do for anyone to be able to merge hundreds of pull requests a month in an enterprise environment where it really matters if the code is correct?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 沙箱 (sandbox)
entities.how_described: 本集说让智能体在沙箱里把代码跑起来——装依赖、启动 localhost、模拟输入、浏览器智能体四处点击搞坏东西——就能以高置信度发现大部分问题。

evidence.quote: And it also spins up your code in a sandbox that installs dependencies, spins up localhost, clicks around to try to break things, mocks inputs, and everything else to figure out if the code is broken.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If you let it spin up the code in a sandbox, have it install the dependencies, mock the inputs, run the browser agents, you can probably start to discover most of the issues that could occur.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
